_about: The sha256 of confidence_precision_map.json at each pinned validator revision, as HuggingFace serves it (read 2026-10-26). tests/conftest.py's stand-in huggingface_hub serves the committed map with that hash, so the tests fail when MODEL_MAP and provenance.json are edited consistently but away from what the hub holds. Record a new revision's hash from the hub itself (hf_hub_download(repo, 'confidence_precision_map.json', revision=...)), never from accuracy_mappings/.
